title: Struktly task lifecycle transition
description: Result of one task lifecycle transition. The transition field names which one, so future transitions can share this document instead of each minting a new schema.

status.description: The status the transition wrote into the task's frontmatter.

rewrite.description: A file whose references to the moved task were rewritten, ordered by path. links counts rewritten references: Markdown link targets plus repository-root path citations in Markdown and Go sources. The task file's own rewritten outbound links are reported under its pre-move path.
